walkthroughs.body_html:
HL Regional Option: History of the Americas — a core area of History.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

HL Regional Option: History of the Americas brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with HL Regional Option: History of the Americas.

mcqs.q: Which Bolshevik slogan summarised Lenin's April Theses?
options: Peace, Land, Bread
Workers of the world unite
Liberte, egalite, fraternite
Better dead than red

mcqs.q: What was the immediate cause of the February Revolution?
options: German invasion
Bread shortages in Petrograd
Lenin's return from Switzerland
Kerensky's offensive

mcqs.q: How was the Cuban Missile Crisis resolved?
options: Kennedy stared Khrushchev down and the Soviets backed off unconditionally.
The Ripper was caught but his name was kept secret to protect the Royal Family.
A secret deal: the USSR withdrew missiles from Cuba; the US publicly pledged not to invade Cuba and secretly agreed to remove Jupiter missiles from Turkey.
The crisis ended when Castro persuaded Khrushchev to withdraw.

mcqs.q: Why were the Whitechapel murders never solved?
options: The Schlieffen Plan failed because it tried to invade Russia first.
The police failed to solve the murders because they didn't try hard enough.
The Ripper was caught but his name was kept secret to protect the Royal Family.
Lack of forensic techniques, no fingerprinting or DNA, conflicting witness accounts, jurisdictional confusion between forces, and possibly police incompetence and media interference.

mcqs.q: Why did the Schlieffen Plan fail in 1914?
options: The Ripper was caught but his name was kept secret to protect the Royal Family.
The Schlieffen Plan failed because Britain entered the war.
Belgian resistance delayed the German advance; Russia mobilised faster than expected; Moltke weakened the right wing; and the French rallied at the Marne.
The Schlieffen Plan failed because it tried to invade Russia first.
